# How-To Guides

How-to guides solve focused RECAP tasks. They assume readers know the relevant
concepts and prioritize an actionable procedure over broad explanation.

Start with [Quick Start: Create and Store Data Locally](quick-start-create-and-store-data-locally.qmd)
if you want to create data without running a server. For server-backed work, use
[Set Up a RECAP Server](setup-recap-server.qmd), then follow the same workflow
with a URL client.
